text:
**Sunday**, and a quiet one.

The big thing this week is the Unit 5 math test, expected around **Thursday**. Your teacher will confirm the day. Tae Kwon Do is Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday evenings, Little Medical School is Friday, and Tae Kwon Do again on Saturday.

Since the test is about dividing, today is a good day to start, not cram. Your Math shelf has a long division review before Unit 5. Try a few problems, check each one by multiplying back, and stop while it still feels easy.
